# NCSD | The National Council for Sustainable Development

> Cambodia's central policy-making body coordinating sustainable development, climate action, green economy, biodiversity conservation, and science & technology initiatives.

NCSD serves as the Royal Government of Cambodia's primary institution for integrating sustainable development across all sectors. The council operates through specialized departments addressing climate change, green economy, biodiversity, and science & technology, while tracking Cambodia's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0) commitments to the UNFCCC.

## Departments & Secretariat

- [General Secretariat](https://ncsd.moe.gov.kh/ncsd/general-secretariat): General Secretariat functions and departmental overview of NCSD
- [Department of Climate Change](https://ncsd.moe.gov.kh/dcc/department-climate-change): Department of Climate Change: climate response coordination and UNFCCC
- [Department of Green Economy](https://ncsd.moe.gov.kh/dge/department-green-economy): Department promoting green development and sustainable economic growth
- [Department of Biodiversity](https://ncsd.moe.gov.kh/dbd/department-biodiversity): Department implementing biodiversity conservation and CBD protocols
- [Department of Science and Technology](https://ncsd.moe.gov.kh/dst/department-science-and-technology): Department advancing science and technology for sustainable development
- [Department of Administration, Planning and Finance](https://ncsd.moe.gov.kh/ncsd/department-administration-planning-and-finance): DAPF department mandate and administrative functions within NCSD

## Policy & Strategic Initiatives

- [Climate Change Policy Hub](https://ncsd.moe.gov.kh/dcc): Climate change policy hub: Cambodia's mitigation and adaptation strategy

- [Policies and Plans](https://ncsd.moe.gov.kh/ncsd/policies-and-plans): Cambodia's key policies and strategic plans on environment and climate
- [Green Economy Initiatives](https://ncsd.moe.gov.kh/dge): Green economy initiatives: sustainable cities, energy, and consumption
- [Biodiversity Conservation](https://ncsd.moe.gov.kh/dbd): Biodiversity overview: conservation, genetic resources, and ecosystem management
